targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(date) AS time, COUNT(*) AS impressions FROM impression GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC;
SELECT to_timestamp(date) AS time, COUNT(*) AS clicks FROM click GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC;

panels.title: Общие затраты на показы по дням

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(date) AS time, SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM impression GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC;

panels.title: Общие затраты на переходы по дням

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(date) AS time, SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM click GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC;

SELECT to_timestamp(i.date) AS time, CASE WHEN COUNT(i.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COUNT(c.id)::decimal / COUNT(i.id)) * 100 END AS conversion_rate FROM impression i LEFT JOIN click c ON i.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND i.date = c.date GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC;

SELECT 'Показов' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS total FROM impression UNION ALL SELECT 'Переходов' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS total FROM click UNION ALL SELECT 'Общие затраты на показы' AS metric, SUM(cost) FROM impression UNION ALL SELECT 'Общие затраты на переходы' AS metric, SUM(cost) FROM click;
SELECT c.ad_title AS campaign, COUNT(i.id) AS impressions FROM impression i JOIN campaign c ON i.campaign_id = c.id GROUP BY c.ad_title ORDER BY impressions DESC;
SELECT c.ad_title AS campaign, COUNT(i.id) AS clicks FROM click i JOIN campaign c ON i.campaign_id = c.id GROUP BY c.ad_title ORDER BY clicks DESC;

panels.title: Затраты на показы по рекламным кампаниям

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.ad_title AS campaign, SUM(cl.cost) AS spent_on_impressions FROM impression cl JOIN campaign c ON cl.campaign_id = c.id GROUP BY c.ad_title ORDER BY spent_on_impressions DESC;

panels.title: Затраты на клики по рекламным кампаниям

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.ad_title AS campaign, SUM(cl.cost) AS spent_on_clicks FROM click cl JOIN campaign c ON cl.campaign_id = c.id GROUP BY c.ad_title ORDER BY spent_on_clicks DESC;

SELECT a.name AS advertiser, COUNT(i.id) AS impressions FROM impression i JOIN campaign c ON i.campaign_id = c.id JOIN advertiser a ON c.advertiser_id = a.id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY impressions DESC;
SELECT a.name AS advertiser, COUNT(cl.id) AS clicks FROM click cl JOIN campaign c ON cl.campaign_id = c.id JOIN advertiser a ON c.advertiser_id = a.id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY clicks DESC;

SELECT a.name AS advertiser, SUM(i.cost) AS spent_on_impressions FROM impression i JOIN campaign c ON i.campaign_id = c.id JOIN advertiser a ON c.advertiser_id = a.id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY spent_on_impressions DESC;

SELECT a.name AS advertiser, SUM(cl.cost) AS spent_on_clicks FROM click cl JOIN campaign c ON cl.campaign_id = c.id JOIN advertiser a ON c.advertiser_id = a.id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY spent_on_clicks DESC;
